journey.title: Where it has been
journey.salvageExplain: A salvage title means an insurer declared the car a total loss after damage, and it was then repaired. Have the repair checked by an independent inspector.
journey.rebuiltExplain: A rebuilt title means the car once had a salvage title, was repaired, and passed a state inspection to return to the road. Have the repair checked by an independent inspector.
journey.floodExplain: A flood title means water damaged the car. Water can harm the wiring, electronics and interior long after they dry. Have it checked by an independent inspector.
journey.hailExplain: Hail damage means hail dented the body. It is usually cosmetic, but check how the panels were repaired.
